design: A woman in her early 40s with a calm, precise Edinburgh Scottish accent. Broadcast newsreader delivery, clear and measured, with a dry hint of humour.
text: Good evening. Hearts are through to the League Cup final after a two-one win over Hibernian at Hampden, with Lawrence Shankland scoring the winner in the eighty-sixth minute.

design: A man in his late 50s with a broad Fife Scottish accent, a pitchside radio reporter. Breathless and thrilled, voice rising with excitement.
text: Oh, he's caught that sweetly! Right off the instep, past the keeper and into the top corner! Hearts lead, and the Wheatfield Stand has gone absolutely daft. Back to you in the studio.

design: A man of sixty-one with a gruff, warm Edinburgh Scottish accent. Slow, grumbling, nostalgic old-timer, a bit weary.
text: Look, in my day a centre-half headed it, and nobody needed a laptop to tell him why. And don't get me started on VAR. Two minutes to look at a toe. A toe!

design: A man of twenty-six with a quick, upbeat Scottish accent. Fast, excitable and chatty, like a football podcaster.
text: The numbers back it up, Fraser. Two point four expected goals from the press alone, and the inverted full-back is the reason. Honestly, I'm making him my differential captain this week.

design: A man in his forties with a broad Gorgie Edinburgh accent, ringing a radio phone-in. Angry and passionate, speaking fast.
text: Aye, hello, it's Davie from Gorgie. I'm sorry, but that substitution on seventy minutes was a joke. We were winning, and he took off the one man who could hold it.

design: A woman in her mid thirties with a clear, warm Scottish accent. Straight-talking and evidence-led, like a football analyst.
text: I would not judge him on one game. The numbers say he has done the work, but let us see him do it again before we crown anyone.

design: A man in his sixties with a Leith Edinburgh accent, ringing a radio phone-in. Wry and a bit weary.
text: Hello, it is Kev from Wester Hailes. I have been going since the eighties, and I will tell you this for nothing, that was the best we have played all season. The manager got it right today and I will say so.
